policy: Every exercise is authorization-gated, consent-based, and evidence-oriented. No exploit delivery, credential capture, remote execution, or persistence testing is permitted by these templates.

templates.name: Identity escalation tabletop
templates.approvalGate: Written rules of engagement and named stakeholder approval.
templates.objective: Measure verification, escalation, and reporting decisions using a fictional identity-change scenario.
stopCriteria: Unapproved participant or asset is encountered
A participant reports distress or confusion
Scenario deviates from the written scope

templates.name: Dependency-change review
templates.approvalGate: Change-management owner approval and a non-production review dataset.
templates.objective: Assess how maintainers verify provenance and escalate suspicious dependency changes without publishing or executing code.
stopCriteria: Any request to alter a production package
Any request to bypass source-control safeguards
